content.glance: Appointment, removal, eligibility, powers and reporting are in ss 139 to 148.
content.study: The auditor is appointed at the AGM for a term to the sixth meeting, with rotation for prescribed classes. Eligibility and disqualification are in s. 141, including the relative and business-relationship bars. Removal before term needs a special resolution and Central Government approval. Duties include inquiry and reporting, and reporting fraud to the Central Government above the prescribed amount under s. 143(12). Cost audit is s. 148.
